cves.description: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of financial records.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Petpooja Munshi
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

cves.description: A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded.

cves.description: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.
